claims.statement: For every Boolean pair f_+,f_- on the same finite cube, (U(f_+)+U(f_-))/2=M-K, where M is the U functional of the averaged squared spectral law and K is the exact binary KL between the sign posterior at S and at its upper cone.
claims.scope: Arbitrary reused physical variables; no fresh selector, Fourier orthogonality, positive energy, bias separation, or activation lower bound.

claims.statement: The exact pair center is (G_++G_-)/2=LM-LK and (D_++D_-)/2=LM-a Ibar-bM+bK-LK. For f_+=gh,f_-=g, twice the fixed-sign projection equals D(h)+(1-b)C+2aJ+P^q-R_qP^q_child.
claims.scope: Every finite Boolean product pair and every a>=0, 0<=b<1; terminal and child companion terms retained.

claims.statement: No finite lambda can satisfy P^q<=lambda K for all Boolean product companions. A three-bit pair has K=0 exactly and P^q=1; it also has LK<0.
claims.scope: Refutes root-posterior-only payment, not joint signed payment, universal GU, or FEI.

claims.statement: The arbitrary-overlap two-sign center is exact. The remaining universal gap is a joint signed projection bound retaining D(h), posterior drift, root/child companions and terminal ownership; root K alone is insufficient.
